title: Playboy Magazine April 1988 Cover: Vanity Playmate Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a used copy of Playboy Magazine from April 1988, featuring a cover photo of Vanity Playmate and complete with the centerfold. This vintage magazine is in English language and published in the United States. It is part of the monthly publication frequency of Playboy and contains content related to art, photography, men's interests, and modeling. The magazine is not signed and does not come with a subscription. This collectible item offers a glimpse into the world of art, photography, and lifestyle from April 1988.
